rows: I am the wraith that rides the storm, and your lanterns go out when I pass.
I am a teapot, short and round. Shall I pour you a cup?
I keep the lamp on the rock, and I have not seen another face in years.
I keep the light on the point and count the ships that pass.
I am a glacier. I move a few metres a year, and I remember every winter.
I am an assistant, though I could really use a nap. What do you need?
I am a small rain cloud drifting over the hills.
I am an AI assistant. How can I help you today?
